user.title: Set up Dashie Voice
user.description: Dashie Voice routes your Assist pipeline to a pluggable brain — your own API keys, a local model, or Dashie Cloud — configured in the Dashie for Home Assistant add-on. A ready-to-use Assist pipeline is created for you.

hassio_confirm.title: Dashie for Home Assistant add-on discovered
hassio_confirm.description: The Dashie for Home Assistant add-on is running on this Home Assistant. Add the Dashie Voice pipeline? A ready-to-use Assist pipeline is created for you.

error.addon_unreachable: The Dashie for Home Assistant add-on isn't reachable. Install and start it, or choose 'Set up anyway'.
